qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree in Sanskrit/ Pali/ Prakrit/ Linguistics/ Manuscriptology
qualification.details: Survey & Cataloguing Expert: Master's degree in Sanskrit/ Pali/ Prakrit/ Linguistics/ Manuscriptology OR Master's degree in History/ Archaeology/ Library & Information Science with Diploma/PG Diploma in Manuscriptology or Conservation AND Minimum 5 years' experience in manuscript survey, cataloguing, manuscript preservation, transcription. Knowledge of regional scripts & languages preferred. Conservation Expert: Master's Degree in Science (with Chemistry as a Subject at Graduation Level) OR Master's Degree in Fine Arts/Visual Arts, OR Master's Degree in Art Conservation/History/Archaeology/Museology/or equivalent subject AND Minimum 5 years' experience in manuscript preservation & conservation, Proven ability to lead a team, and computer skills. Formal training in Conservation of Manuscripts and Art objects from a reputed National-level institution such as NRLC (not less than six months). Assistant Conservator: Bachelor's Degree in Science (with Chemistry as a Subject at Graduation Level) OR Bachelor's Degree in Fine Arts/Visual Arts, OR Bachelor's Degree in Art Conservation / History/ Archaeology / Museology / or equivalent subject. Script & Language Expert: Master's Degree in Sanskrit/ Pali/ Prakrit/ History/Urdu/Persian or in any one of the languages mentioned in Eighth Schedule of Constitution AND Possessing expertise in any one Language and Script viz. Brahmi, Sarada, Grantha, Bengali, Odiya, Telugu, Tamil etc. AND At least 5 years of experience in script reading, decoding and translation, editing AND Capable for editorial and documentation support.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for MSU Baroda Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.msubaroda.ac.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 25-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MSU Baroda recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications for the MSU Baroda recruitment is 25th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by MSU Baroda?
faq.answer: MSU Baroda has released a total of 5 vacancies for various posts, including Survey & Cataloguing Expert, Conservation Expert, Assistant Conservator, and Script & Language Expert.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 40,000/- per month, depending on the specific post and qualifications of the selected candidate.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications vary for each post, ranging from Master's degrees in subjects like Sanskrit, Chemistry, History, Linguistics, and Fine Arts to Bachelor's degrees in Science or Fine Arts, along with specific experience requirements.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for MSU Baroda recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial application submission followed by a walk-in interview. Candidates are shortlisted based on their applications and then appear for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda, which is www.msubaroda.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions are on a contractual basis. This means that the employment will be for a fixed period as per the terms and conditions mentioned in the appointment letter.

faq.question: Q10. Which city is the job located in?
faq.answer: The jobs are located in Vadodara, Gujarat, with the pincode 390001.
